Retry helps with an intermittent stall, but does it help if the export itself just takes longer than the timeout window every time — say a big dataset that consistently takes 45s? If so, retrying the same request just times out again the same way.

Also: is the retry idempotent on the backend, or does each attempt kick off a fresh export job? If it's the latter, a flaky connection could end up spawning multiple export runs for one user click.

What's the cap — does it retry forever, or fail after N attempts with an error the user actually sees?
